exposure: Systemic AAV92YF-scCAG-PGRN delivery at post-natal day 3 or 4
cohort: The study participants were progranulin knockout mice, a model for CLN11, exhibiting retinal degeneration.
finding: Delivery of progranulin gene therapy is time-sensitive and dependent on the route of administration, with early systemic delivery reducing retinal thinning and pathological deposits, while later intravitreal delivery showed no improvement or even thinner retinas.
